name: Concrete volume estimator
summary: Rectangular slab/footing volume from length, width, and depth, with a unit tag.
author: friday-core
description: Volume = L×W×D in the units you name (default metres). This is a planning aid, not a substitute for a licensed engineer's calculations or sign-off, and it is not professional certification. Order extra for waste with con-waste-factor; this skill does not design mix or rebar.
